# White Physiotherapy Clinic

> Rehab | Fitness | Nutrition. Physiotherapy in Nigeria: home visits, 30-day guided recovery programmes delivered on WhatsApp, and in-person sessions at FlexRecovery Studio.

## Care options

- Home physiotherapy visits: a physiotherapist comes to your home for assessment and hands-on treatment. Suitable for elderly mobility, stroke rehabilitation, post-surgery rehab, shoulder and hip pain, and posture and spine correction.
- Recovery programmes on WhatsApp: guided programmes for sciatica (lower back pain), piriformis syndrome (buttock pain), cervical spondylosis (neck pain) and knee arthritis (knee pain). Each opens a WhatsApp chat with a physiotherapist.
- Corporate Wellness (https://whitephysiotherapyclinic.com.ng/corporate-wellness): ergonomic strategies and physiotherapy brought to your office to ease desk-related back and neck pain and lower absenteeism.
- FlexRecovery Studio: an in-person recovery studio run by White Physiotherapy.
